messages:
Maya: Quick design review for compact Playground streaming. Goals: reduce clutter, single primary control, token visibility without noise, safe prompt insert. Prototype linked.

Aisha: Agree overlay on last message for desktop, slim banner for mobile. Keep label short: 'Streaming…'.

Sam: Implementation: absolutely position overlay to avoid reflow, throttle UI updates (80ms). Use aria-live for status.

Diego: Single primary control only. Icon-only stop in compact mode, expanded 'Stop response' in normal. No pause.

Liam: Token badge: composer footer, right-aligned, abbreviated visually ('~98 tkns') and full SR text 'Approx 98 tokens used'. Add setting to hide it.

Aisha: Prompt library: insert collapsed snippet (title + preview) not full text. Expand on click to fetch full prompt. Show undo toast.

Maya: Copy: after stream ends show 'Regenerate response' (explicit). Ensure accessible labels and focus stays in composer. Next: Aisha iterate mocks, Sam prototype, Liam draft a11y checklist.
